purpose: The controller (repair_guard.plan_problems) accepts a repeated-mechanism pivot only from an independent reviewer's JSON with these exact fields. Fill the judgment yourself. A revise verdict is returned honestly if the replacement is not a real change of mechanism or is unsafe. Echo the bindings exactly (a Read-only reviewer can't hash).

required_fields.reviewer_identity: your identity, not the director claude-sonnet-5-5
required_fields.reviewed_failure_sha256: echo the list in bindings.reviewed_failure_sha256 after you have read each failure file
required_fields.visible_difference: >=40 chars, what is audibly and measurably different about the replacement
required_fields.source_basis: >=30 chars, the retained evidence you relied on (file and measured value)
required_fields.house_rule_check: your finding on whether the two commas obey the house punctuation rules and change no spoken word or claim
